topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture topic, reviews prior concepts, and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic drivers in tumor development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations drive Darwinian selection and clonal expansion during cancer progression.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies, cancer stem cells, and cell of origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine stem cell hierarchies, cancer stem cell models, and experimental evidence identifying the cell of origin in leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, chronic inflammation, and stromal dependence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how microenvironmental factors, inflammatory signaling, and stromal dependencies drive tumor outgrowth and support established tumors.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental model systems and single-cell and spatial technologies used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of mutational, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors in cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the genetic, epigenetic, cellular, and microenvironmental components that collectively govern cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
